mapper.sql: id, dept_code AS code, dept_name AS name, dept_type AS type, active

where.if: AND (dept_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO department (dept_code, dept_name, dept_type, active) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{type}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE department SET active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
